props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Configure Apache Parquet to mitigate: Data contamination

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Risk description: Data contamination occurs when incorrect data is used for training. For example, data that is not aligned with model's purpose or data that is already set aside for other development tasks such as testing and evaluation. Concern: Data that differs from the intended training data might skew model accuracy and affect model outcomes. Define standards for how Apache Parquet is used to store and serve datasets for AI (including schema design, compression and encoding choices, partitioning strategy, encryption, and access control) so that this risk is mitigated. Ensure that Parquet metadata and schema evolution practices do not introduce hidden changes in the data seen by models, and that downstream Hugging Face Transformers training and evaluation jobs can reliably interpret the stored columns for this risk dimension.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy (%), F1-score, Precision, Recall, Perplexity, BLEU, ROUGE on models trained/evaluated using datasets stored in Parquet

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Implement data quality and evaluation jobs that read Parquet-backed datasets into Hugging Face Transformers training/eval pipelines and into scanning tools. For each dataset, compute the Associated_Metric values (e.g., accuracy and F1 on benchmarks, fairness scores, PII detection/recall, toxicity rates) and compare them against baseline non-Parquet datasets or prior versions of the same dataset. Track these metrics per Parquet dataset, schema version, and storage location, and alert when thresholds in this benchmark are breached.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, Precision, Recall, Perplexity, BLEU, ROUGE

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Parquet-backed datasets used for AI training and evaluation preserve model accuracy metrics within 10% of baseline Hugging Face model card values when compared to reference non-Parquet data representations

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: ≤10% deviation from baseline

props.name: HF_Metric_Match
props.value: Yes

props.name: Mapping_Notes

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Risk description: A type of adversarial attack where an adversary or malicious insider injects intentionally corrupted, false, misleading, or incorrect samples into the training or fine-tuning datasets. Concern: Poisoning data can make the model sensitive to a malicious data pattern and produce the adversary's desired output. It can create a security risk where adversaries can force model behavior for their own benefit. Define standards for how Apache Parquet is used to store and serve datasets for AI (including schema design, compression and encoding choices, partitioning strategy, encryption, and access control) so that this risk is mitigated.
